name: mosaic-gallery-grid
title: Mosaic Gallery Grid
description: Staggered geometric visual gallery grid with varied aspect ratio image apertures and hover zoom bounds.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Luxury
Macrostructure: Mosaic
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Serif Display
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Mosaic Aperture Presentation: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
